{"metadata":{"description":"OpenCode notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: separate pickers for turn finished, permission requested, and turn error.","id":"gh:1435888522","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-occlick","slug":"contraliz/dsh-occlick","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","notifications","opencode","plugin","sound-effects"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OpenCode notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: separate pickers for turn finished, permission re"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"quested, and turn error."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-occlick"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Plays OpenCode notification sounds in DeepSeek Harness** — one clip when a turn finishes, one when"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" the agent asks for permission, and one when a turn fails, each with its own picker from the whole O"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"penCode sound library."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"OpenCode ships a small library of notification clips for its desktop app. This plugin brings that li"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"brary to DSH and plays one when a turn finishes, when the agent asks for permission, and when a turn"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" fails, so you can look away while a long task runs and hear when the agent needs you."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*Settings → Sound effects: one picker per event, all 45 OpenCode clips, plus **Off (silent)**. Choos"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ing a clip auditions it immediately.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Event | Source | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Turn finished | Session `running: true → false` | Plays the turn clip once |
| Permission requeste"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"d | `approval/request` | Plays the permission clip, then passes the request to the approval UI |
| T"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"urn ended on an error | `api-session/error` | Plays the error clip; the following turn end stays sil"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ent |
| User stops the turn | Stop button or `Esc` `Esc` | Silent; a stopped turn did not finish |
|"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" Flicker at boot or reconnect | `true → false` within ~250 ms | Silent |
| A run already going at pa"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ge load | `running: true` on the first snapshot | Sounds only after ~2 s of observed running |
| Rep"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"eated idle refresh | `false → false` | Silent |
| Subagent Session | `origin: subagent` | Silent |
|"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" Mounted over an idle list | — | Silent (no history replay) |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Three channels, three pickers**: turn finished, permission requested, and turn ended on an error"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" each choose their own clip.
- **One click per event**: sounds follow the event, not every step, too"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"l call, or streamed token. A failed turn plays the error clip instead of the turn-finished clip, nev"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"er both.
- **45 sounds each**: everything OpenCode ships — Alert, Bip-bop, Nope, Staplebops, and Yup"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" — with an instant preview as you choose.
- **Configured in DSH**: the same pickers appear on **Sett"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ings → Sound effects** and on the plugin's own row under **Plugins**, so they follow the normal enab"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"le/disable and uninstall flow.
- **Quiet where it should be**: subagent turns stay silent, a stopped"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" turn stays silent, a burst of approval requests plays once, and opening or reloading the harness ca"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"nnot replay an old turn end."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Because DSH publishes running state per Session, a turn that ends while you are looking elsewhere st"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ill makes the sound. An error is remembered per Session for 15 seconds, so the failed turn does not "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"also play the turn-finished clip. Approval requests are coalesced within 1.5 seconds, so a burst sou"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" the turn-finished clip. Approval requests are coalesced within 1.5 seconds, so a burst sounds once."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Requires **DSH 0.2.0 or later** and the Web client (the desktop app, or `dsh web`). The plugin is a "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Cordis client bundle; it needs a page to render settings into and an audio output."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### From the Plugins page"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin**.
2. Paste the repository address:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**.
4. Open **Settings → Sound effects** and pick a clip."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### From the command line"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Copy the line for the profile that matches how you run DSH:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart DSH after a command-line install: bundle entries are composed at startup. To uninstall, use "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"the same command with `remove dsh-occlick`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### From a checkout"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Choose the sounds"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Open **Settings → Sound effects**, or **Plugins → dsh-occlick → Configure**. Both show the same thre"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e selectors, each listing every clip and labelled the way OpenCode labels them."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Every channel also offers **Off (silent)**, so one event can be muted while the others keep sounding"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"very channel also offers **Off (silent)**, so one event can be muted while the others keep sounding."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The defaults are the clips OpenCode's own desktop app uses for the same events:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Channel | Default | OpenCode equivalent |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Turn finished | `staplebops-01` | Agent complete |
| Permission requested | `staplebops-02` | Perm"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ission required |
| Turn ended on an error | `nope-03` | Error |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Choosing a sound saves it and plays it immediately, so you can audition without waiting for an event"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"hoosing a sound saves it and plays it immediately, so you can audition without waiting for an event."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Family | Count | Library names |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Alert | 10 | `alert-01` … `alert-10` |
| Bip-bop | 10 | `bip-bop-01` … `bip-bop-10` |
| Nope | 12 "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"| `nope-01` … `nope-12` |
| Staplebops | 7 | `staplebops-01` … `staplebops-07` |
| Yup | 6 | `yup-01"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"`nope-12` |
| Staplebops | 7 | `staplebops-01` … `staplebops-07` |
| Yup | 6 | `yup-01` … `yup-06` |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The choices are stored in the browser under `dsh-occlick.turn`, `dsh-occlick.permission`, and `dsh-o"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"cclick.error`, so they are per browser rather than per profile. A turn sound saved by version `0.2.x"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"` (`dsh-occlick.sound`) is carried over. Clearing site data restores the defaults."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Category"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"**Integrations & Connections** — the plugin turns DSH's existing turn, approval, and error signals i"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"nto a local notification channel. It connects no external service, adds no model, tool, or skill, an"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"d changes no conversation content."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Suggested tags: `notifications`, `sound`, `audio`, `accessibility`, `opencode`."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Permissions and risk"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"`dsh-occlick` is a client-side Cordis bundle with an empty host half. It requests no DSH permission,"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" no tool, no shell command, no filesystem path, and no credential."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"| Requirement | Notes |"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"| DSH **0.2.0+** | Uses client slots, `sessions.list`, `remote.$on`, and `ctx.locale`; the package d"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"eclares `engines.dsh` |
| Web client | Desktop app or `dsh web`. Headless/TUI profiles have no setti"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"ngs page and no audio output, so the plugin is inert there |
| Chromium/Electron WebView | Needs `HT"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"MLAudioElement`, `localStorage`, and CSS custom properties |
| Node.js 22+ | Development only (build"},{"id":"p42s5","text":" and tests); the installed plugin does not run Node |
| Browser storage enabled | Choices fall back "},{"id":"p42s6","text":"to defaults when storage is blocked |"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"Tested on the DSH desktop app 0.2.1 on Windows 11. If the pickers do not appear on another DSH versi"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"on, the client slot API changed; please open an issue with the DSH version."}],"truncated":true}
